'''Voltverine''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Voltling]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Voltreaver]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Thanks to countless 'just passing by' rescues, Voltverine has become incredibly fast. After all, nothing beats pure speed in combat. A flash of lightning, and those [[Zobos]] are gone."

Voltverine is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A yellow and white, bipedal, wolf-like creature that wears a red bandana around its neck and red arm wraps. It's also always holding a small blade of grass in its mouth. It has large claws and a scar across one eye, as well as a tear in one ear. Its hind legs and the tips of its ears are dark brown.

Voltverine's 's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces yellow with blue, and red becomes yellow. Dark brown also becomes dark purple.

== Evolution Trial ==
Voltverine's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Voltreaver]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Raise this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Marathon Party]] (use boards x6000) or [[Fishing Contest]] (use Fishing Rod x6000).
* Own 5 Lightning [[Badge Dojo|Badges]].

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Just give Voltverine two katanas and a red mask, and maybe Voltpool will show up."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Dreams of playing a hero on the silver screen. until then, Volverine protects the weak without hesitation."
